name: inplace_guard
description: Verify that the source integration checkout is on its expected branch and commit. Used before local merge and as the final source-handoff proof. Inputs: repoPath, branch, expectedHead, expectedStatusFingerprint?.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the integration git checkout to verify.

branch.description: Branch name the checkout is expected to still be on.

expectedHead.description: Commit SHA (or ref resolvable to one) the checkout is expected to still be at.

expectedStatusFingerprint.description: Optional working-tree status fingerprint from an earlier checkpoint; when set, the checkout must also still match it (no uncommitted changes since).

repoPath.description: Resolved absolute path of the verified checkout.

branch.description: Actual current branch, confirmed equal to the expected branch.

head.description: Actual current HEAD commit SHA, confirmed equal to the canonicalized expectedHead.

statusFingerprint.description: Actual working-tree status fingerprint at verification time.

matched.description: Always true on success; the task fails instead of returning false.
